analysis: Execution succeeded, but validation HR@10 fell to 0.5750: −0.0150 versus the previous 0.5900 and −0.0450 versus the historical 0.6200. Category HR@10 was Movies 0.645, Industrial 0.565, Electronics 0.380, and CDs 0.710. Against the supplied previous category scores, only Industrial improved (+0.005); Movies, Electronics, and CDs declined. This trial does not support separating context and scoring embeddings under the current training setup. The metrics do not establish the cause of the regression.
code_summary: SASRec uses independent input item_emb and candidate output_emb tables, initialized identically without additional random draws. Positive, 16-negative, and inference scoring use output_emb; sequence encoding uses item_emb. The 17-way cross-entropy, optimizer, MultVAE reconstruction with auxiliary continuation supervision, and reciprocal-rank fusion (75% MultVAE, 25% SASRec) remain unchanged. Checkpoints and the generated predictor reconstruct both tables, with isolated gradient, reload, and predictor-agreement checks. All four dataset routes are retained.
